notes:
METHOD. 81 frames were sampled every 0.5 s (frames 0,15,...,1185 plus 1199 for t=40 s). Per frame: SIFT (9000 features, top 110 px masked) + RANSAC homography (3 px) to the neighbours at +-0.5 s and +-1.0 s (92-97% inliers; median feature residual 0.3-0.5 px, p95 2-5 px). Proposals: (1) motion-compensated differences (min over the two directions, same-sign filter, blobs of vehicle/person size) and a dense-flow anomaly map (Farneback after homography warp, local-median flow removed); (2) YOLO VisDrone-yolo26x on 8 overlapping 640 px tiles per frame at imgsz 1280, conf 0.15 (8271 boxes over t=0.5..39.5), each box template-searched (NCC) in the +-0.5/+-1.0 s warped neighbours; boxes whose displacement beats the local static level in both directions (572 flagged) were linked into 97 chains. Every chain, every residual flow chain in the upper 2/3 of the frame, and lower-frame flow overlays at 8 times were inspected on crop strips/sheets of warped frames (sheets/L_*.jpg, un1_*.jpg, anom1_*.jpg, ped2_*.jpg, V1..V5, G*.jpg, H1*.jpg, W1*.jpg, zones/*.jpg). Verified movers were then tracked every 0.5 s (detector boxes where the detector fired, NCC template tracking / hand-placed boxes elsewhere; 'hard': true marks sightings that are interpolated, template-tracked, hand-placed, partially occluded (hedge, tree, roof canopy, poles) or cut by the frame edge; their boxes are +-3-6 px accurate, others are detector boxes). Boxes are clipped to the frame. Frame k is at t=k/30. Only t=0.5..39.5 s are annotated (frames 15..1185): objects already moving at t=0 (m1, m2, m3, m4 and probably more) or still in view at t=40 are visible slightly outside the annotated window.
PARALLAX / STATIC LEVEL. For parked cars near the image centre the NCC-search displacement against +-0.5 s is p50=0, p90=1.0, p95=1.4 px (after homography); it grows to 3-8 px per 0.5 s near the image edges and for tall/near objects (roof vents, chimneys, poles, tree crowns, building edges). Parked car at the right edge (1840,550) drifts 8 px/0.5 s together with the building next to it; a parked trailer at (1704,400) drifts 2 px/0.5 s. True movers here move 10-60 px/0.5 s, the slow ones 3-9 px/0.5 s.
SPEED. speed_est_mps = ground-relative image displacement per 0.5 s converted with 4.5 m = the object's median box length (crude, foreshortening ignored; +-40%). 'slow' = under 2 m/s. Objects that decelerate to a stop (m1 start, m7 stop line, m6, m14 turning point, m13 start) have slow sightings inside an otherwise 'normal' track.
CLASSES. Pickup trucks are labelled 'truck' with cls_alt 'car' (the detector calls them car/truck inconsistently); SUVs/sedans 'car'.
NOT INCLUDED / REJECTED. All roof vents, chimneys, poles, tree/bush clumps, stop sign, red 'parked' car in driveway (~(760,790)), parked car next to the right-edge building (1800,540), parked grey trailer at (1704,400), black pickup in front of the mall doors (~(640,262), measured static over t=30-38 s by NCC drift) were checked and rejected as static/parallax. No pedestrian or cyclist could be verified (no detector box of class pedestrian/people/bicycle/motor had a consistent ground-relative displacement; persons near the mall doors are tiny, <=8x15 px, and none was seen to translate): the list contains vehicles only. Possible extra slow movers NOT listed because the displacement stayed within ~1-2 px per 0.5 s: a gray truck at ~(904,230) t=3-7 s (maybe creeping left at ~1.3 px/0.5 s) and several cars manoeuvring in the dense far lot at t=20-40 s.
UNCERTAIN CASES. m10/m9: the light-gray SUV/pickup of the 'O14b' track drives left until t~15 s then disappears behind the foreground roof edge, and a white pickup appears at the same spot at t=16.5-17.5 s and drives right for the rest of the clip - almost certainly the same vehicle (U-turn), kept as two objects with possible_same_as. m8 (small dark car behind the apartment block) and the sightings of m2 at t=0.5-1.0 s (behind a roof canopy) use hand-placed boxes. m3 (black pickup, t=5.5-9 s) and m4 are partly hidden behind hedge/poles, boxes there are approximate. m12 is tiny (~18x8 px) and faint. m13 starts from standstill at t~22 s (first moving sighting t=22.0 s). Object identity continuity inside the dense lot (m10, m16, m4, m3) was judged by eye.
